verdict.rationale: Runloop explicitly documents official SDKs 'in common languages to interact with the Runloop API' plus a CLI (rli), Cursor IDE rule files for SDK-aware assistance, and multiple tutorials showing SDK usage (OpenAI Agents SDK integration, Browserbase, Kernel, OpenCode) demonstrating real-world SDK-based builds. Missing for 10: no explicit list of supported languages/versions, no independent third-party corroboration of SDK quality, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s) which would strengthen SDK completeness claims.
